g.text: Train your own model, step by step
Asha, today you train a real language model yourself, on this computer, in about 2 minutes. It's built exactly like MONA, just
100× smaller. Choose a step and press Enter to run it. Go in order: 1 → 6.
Show it text, let it guess the next token, measure how wrong it was (the
loss), and nudge every number to do better. 300 times. Watch the loss fall
How the full-size MONA did this step:
▶ Press Enter to run this step
Running on: cpu (CPU, because MONA's own training is using the GPU right
↑↓ step Enter run Esc back F1 explain a word
